topics.title: Europe gathers for eclipse day
topics.summary: A rare total solar eclipse crosses Greenland, Iceland, Spain and a corner of Portugal today, with big crowds, safety campaigns and livestreams helping people watch without eye damage.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the room would become the official eclipse-glasses inspector, and who would mostly be there for the weird lighting and snacks?

topics.title: Perseids peak under dark skies
topics.summary: The Perseid meteor shower peaks tonight into Thursday morning, with a new moon giving many Northern Hemisphere skywatchers a better chance at seeing bright meteors after dark.
topics.discussionPrompt: If everyone went meteor watching, who would bring a blanket and patience, and who would start naming every streak across the sky?

topics.title: UK weighs fire-prevention steps
topics.summary: During another intense heatwave, UK officials are considering limits on disposable barbecues as dry conditions, drought worries and wildfire risks keep pressure on public-safety planning.
topics.discussionPrompt: What tiny summer habit would each person reluctantly give up if it actually made parks and neighborhoods safer?

topics.title: Spain plans careful eclipse crowds
topics.summary: Spanish communities along the eclipse path are preparing official viewing areas, access limits and fire-safety rules as visitors pour in during hot, dry summer conditions.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would love a perfectly organized viewing zone, and who would wander off looking for the quietest hill with the best view?
